The listed lawful facilities for discarded vehicles, tires, and appliances include a salvage yard, permitted disposal location, or a demolisher's business premises.

lines.text: Vehicle litter points to the driver
First littering carries fine and service

narration.text: Secure the private trash load so it cannot fall, drop, or blow out, and use lawful disposal facilities. Litter deposited from a motor vehicle other than a motor bus is treated as initial evidence that the driver deposited it. For a first littering conviction under the provisions described on this page, the guide gives a fine from 100 to 1,000 dollars and up to eight hours of community service. For another such littering conviction within three years of the first, the guide gives a fine from 200 to 2,000 dollars and possible community service of up to 24 hours.
